responsibility: This file provides GCC’s core RTL jump and label maintenance utilities plus a small barrier-cleanup pass. It rebuilds JUMP_LABEL fields, REG_LABEL_TARGET/OPERAND notes, and LABEL_NUSES counts across an insn chain; offers common backend helpers such as jump redirection, inversion, true_regnum, reg_or_subregno, and renumber-aware RTL equality; and normalizes misplaced or duplicate BARRIERs after CFG-affecting transformations. Its responsibility is infrastructure for maintaining and reasoning about RTL jumps and labels, not a full standalone jump-optimization pass as in older GCC versions.
